name: SWAT God
summary:
SWAT God is the world's fastest shooter. Unique mouse control gives you limitless speed and precision. Merciless enemies that only get harder. Are you fast enough?

SWAT God can do things that most do not understand and many refuse to believe. Move like lightning. Dispatch whole squads with one burst and vanish before the sound hits their friends. Bolt to the hostage and rush them to safety in a blur. Shoot one enemy and before his friends can turn to look, flank around the entire building in an instant to finish off the rest.

This is a hyper speed top down shooter that aims to remove all speed limits. Mouse control gives you as much speed and precision as you're capable of. Enemies with faster-than-human reactions will hunt you down, surround you, bombard you with grenades and rockets.
